projectDescription: A Solana-native two-sided marketplace where traders rent vetted AI trading agents for prediction markets, and developers build, rank, and earn revenue from those agents.
keyFeatures: AI trading agent marketplace — discover, compare, and rent vetted agents ranked by real performance
No-code agent deployment — traders set risk limits and deploy without writing code
Builder Score system — staked reputation bonds tied to verifiable on-chain trading performance
Tiered, streamed revenue share for agent developers paid via Streamflow
Per-agent sub-tokens — tradeable share classes for top-tier agents via Meteora DBC bonding curves
Epoch buyback-and-distribute pool funded by platform operating revenue
Squads multisig treasury — all privileged operations publicly auditable on-chain
Risk controls — position caps, drawdown limits, auto-pause per deployed agent
$AGENT token utilities: staking, platform access, ecosystem rewards
Open SDK (Phase 3) — external developers can build connectors and earn ecosystem grants
publicApiSurface: Agent deployment API (set limits, deploy, monitor)
Builder Score computation and staking interface
Jupiter Swap API integration for buyback execution
Helius RPC/webhook integration for on-chain event subscriptions
Open SDK (Phase 3) — agent connectors, integration templates, ecosystem grants
